Design locked 2026-09-05, not yet implemented: a personal/single-user device (no other union members ever reachable) should degrade this to a 'solo claim' -- instant, self-attested, logged distinctly as SOLO -- unwitnessed rather than treated like a real witnessed quorum claim. See os-lineages.md section 3's 'undermanned fallback, made concrete' for the full reasoning (it's a genuine security tradeoff -- one compromised identity is enough for root on a solo claim, not just a lesser/simpler quorum). Needs Console.gd to know whether the current node is solo vs. multi-user before this can be built; quorum_required below still assumes the multi-user station case.
